name: Vietnam
visaRequirements: Visa-free or visa-on-arrival for many nationalities; always check current entry rules before travel
languages: English widely spoken in tourist hubs
bestExperience: Best experience: riding the Ha Giang Loop — the best experience of the entire trip.

about.description: Vietnam stretches from lush Mekong Delta rice paddies to the dramatic peaks of Ha Giang and the rich history of Hanoi. It offers bustling cities, peaceful countryside and unforgettable food experiences.
highlights: Dynamic street food culture and coffee shops
Iconic landscapes from Ha Long Bay to the limestone cliffs of Ninh Binh
Colorful central coast cities like Hoi An and Hue
A scenic northern loop through Ha Giang

travelTips.bestTimeToVisit: February to April and August to October for the most pleasant weather across the country
transportation: Domestic flights connect major cities quickly
Trains are a scenic option for the north-south route
Grab app and taxis are common in cities
culturalNotes: Dress modestly at temples and pagodas
Bargaining is expected in markets but keep it friendly
Try local street food carefully and carry water for hot days
